answer: Each identity carries an opal juror badge and must serve rotating jury duty: seven random peers whisper their private votes on a sample of its claimed work. A fraud verdict burns the identity's whole epoch earnings and bans it for ten epochs, while jurors voting against clear evidence lose 5,000 POA each. A violet flag marks any identity under review, barring new jobs until cleared. Jury service costs 4,000 POA per identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 4,000,000 POA while an honest agent pays 4,000 once. Weakness: a coordinated jury majority can frame an honest agent.
